concept.title: Your encounters become cards
concept.text: Photograph an animal, the AI identifies it and you earn its card: real rarity, fun facts, songs and calls. Fill your Bestiary one species at a time.

rules.title: Wild, alive and respected
rules.text: A few simple rules so every card is worth something.

items.title: Living animals
items.text: Wild, in a park or domestic: photograph a real animal you saw yourself.

items.title: One photo, one species
items.text: Several photos of the same species share one card; only the first earns full XP.

items.title: No screens, eggs or dead animals
items.text: Screen photos, plush toys, eggs, larvae or dead animals are rejected.

items.title: Never disturb
items.text: Keep your distance and leave nests and habitats untouched.

features.title: Explore, vote and level up
features.text: Three ways to enjoy the adventure beyond the photo.

radar.title: Zone radar
radar.text: On the map, scan an area to see recently spotted species and those waiting to be found.

contest.title: Photo contest
contest.text: Every week, enter your best shot and vote for the community: +5 XP per vote.

boosters.title: Boosters and leagues
boosters.text: Level up to unlock new collections and climb your weekly league.

ready.title: The wild is waiting
ready.text: Head out, keep your eyes open and capture your first species. Your Bestiary starts now.

card.title: Faunex has changed a lot
card.text: Rules, radar, contest, boosters: the tour in 30 seconds.
